summary.en: Kogoro and Conan are on their way home when they witness a struggle between two men over a backpack. Later, one of the men fell off the building and died. Location: Train station Victim: Keisuke Furuta Cause of death: Fell from the train station Suspects: Hideki Sugimoto The police question the other man named Hideki Sugimoto. He said that his backpack was stolen while he was in the washroom, and he was trying to retrieve it from the other man, Keisuke Furuta.
